description: This Java class 'ICalWorker' handles WebDAV requests related to iCalendar data, including GET, PUT, and PROPFIND operations, for work effort entities in the OFBiz framework. It delegates calendar conversion tasks to 'ICalConverter' and manages HTTP responses and user authentication.

classes.name: ResponseProperties
classes.description: Encapsulates HTTP response status code and message for WebDAV operations.

classes.name: ICalWorker
classes.description: Handles WebDAV requests for iCalendar data related to work efforts, including GET, PUT, and PROPFIND methods, with user authentication and response management.

methods.name: createConversionContext
methods.description: Creates a context map from the HTTP request attributes, parameters, and locale for calendar conversion.

methods.name: createForbiddenResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object with HTTP 403 Forbidden status.

methods.name: createNotAuthorizedResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object with HTTP 401 Unauthorized status.

methods.name: createNotFoundResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object with HTTP 404 Not Found status.

methods.name: createOkResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object with HTTP 200 OK status.

methods.name: createPartialContentResponse
methods.description: Returns a ResponseProperties object with HTTP 206 Partial Content status.

methods.name: getLastModifiedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last modified date of the work effort's iCalendar data.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Processes HTTP GET requests to retrieve iCalendar data for a work effort.

methods.name: handlePropFindRequest
methods.description: Processes WebDAV PROPFIND requests to retrieve properties of the iCalendar resource.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Processes HTTP PUT requests to update the iCalendar data for a work effort.

methods.name: isValidRequest
methods.description: Validates the request's security and presence of workEffortId.

methods.name: logInUser
methods.description: Authenticates user based on request credentials and sets user info in request/session.

methods.name: setupRequest
methods.description: Extracts workEffortId from request path and performs user login.

methods.name: writeResponse
methods.description: Writes the ResponseProperties to the HTTP response, setting headers and status.
